thought: Song Xueyi is a regular soldier in the sixth squad, distinguished by his simple/honest face and exceptional self-control in extreme situations, as seen when he resists temptation despite thirst. He is one of the two survivors. Comparing with others: Ma Baoyu has binoculars and thick eyebrows; Ge Zhenlin has a square jaw and rolled-up sleeves; the Hu brothers are cheerful. Song Xueyi's most distinctive visual feature is his round, soft facial structure with a clean-shaven, youthful appearance, which contrasts sharply with Ge Zhenlin's angular jaw and Ma Baoyu's lean features. This gives him an approachable yet disciplined look, reinforced by his neatly maintained uniform. The round face is the primary anchor for consistency, as it is a permanent physical trait not dependent on expression or posture.
distinctive_features: Round, soft facial features with a clean-shaven, youthful appearance and neatly maintained uniform
prompt: Full body portrait of an Eighth Route Army soldier standing in a disciplined, upright stance, embodying self-control and principle. The man has distinctively round, soft facial features with a clean-shaven, youthful appearance that conveys honesty and resilience. His uniform is neatly maintained, with every button fastened and gear orderly, reflecting his unwavering discipline. He wears a blue-gray Eighth Route Army uniform jacket, standard military cap with red star emblem, brown leather belt with ammunition pouches, dark cotton pants, and clean cloth shoes. A rifle is held securely at his side in a respectful, ready position. Centered composition, symmetrical framing, eye-level angle. The subject stands against a single colored deep olive green background with high contrast separation, creating a clear silhouette. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the front, casting soft shadows that emphasize his round facial structure and the neatness of his uniform. Cool to neutral color temperature with low-saturation earth tones - muted slate blues, weathered grays, dusty browns. The lighting highlights the smooth contours of his face and the orderly lines of his attire. Solemn, resilient, and principled atmosphere, reflecting the gravity of 1941 wartime China and his role as a survivor. Realistic, thick-painted 2D animation style with bold, visible brushstrokes and strong contrast between light and shadow, emphasizing the harsh dignity and epic nature of historical events. Deep focus keeping the entire figure sharp from head to toe. Non-distorted portrait lens with natural perspective. The overall mood conveys quiet determination, inner strength, and unwavering adherence to duty. Cultural portraiture, historically accurate 1941 Chinese Eighth Route Army uniform and equipment, realistic rendering with painterly texture.
ref_description: Soldier with round, soft facial features and neatly maintained uniform
